init.title: IoX Options
init.description:
Set the options for the IoX integration: 
 • Node Sensor String: Any device or folder that contains 'Node Sensor String' in the name will be treated as a sensor or binary sensor. 
 • Ignore String: Any device with 'Ignore String' in the name will be ignored. 
 • Variable Sensor String: Any variable that contains 'Variable Sensor String' will be added as a sensor. 
 • Restore Light Brightness: If enabled, the previous brightness will be restored when turning on a light instead of the device's built-in On-Level. 
 • Enable Adding Variable, Node Server, Network Resource, or Program Entities: If you don't use any of these features you can disable them to speed up loading times.

send_node_command.name: Send node command
send_node_command.description: Send a friendly-named command to an IoX device by entity ID. Valid commands: beep, brighten, dim, disable, enable, fade_down, fade_stop, fade_up, fast_off, fast_on, query.
